title: The Worthy Thanksgiving
english: It is worthy and just that our God be thanked without ceasing for all your benefits which you have bestowed upon us. First, that you sent to us from heaven your holy child, the co-throne of your kingdom, your companion son, the God Word, who, coming upon the last of the days, having taken our humanity, the Word became flesh without remaining as a mere change. Through the Holy Spirit, he possessed flesh and a human soul, having all the things of man without sin. He did not dwell as if in some man, but he himself, entirely the God Word, having been perfectly eaten, did not alter humanity; not two existing, but one King, one Christ, one.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
